scope: AAA-022 W1 session-title asynchronous provider history loading, synchronous citation-index migration, and exact app-boot startup enforcement for both shipped title providers

criteria.description: Confirmed authority covers this owner-scoped asynchronous title-history reader and synchronous pre-commit citation seam; S071 telemetry capture, broad lint/compiler changes, released generations, publication, push, merge, release, and final-verdict actions remain excluded.
criteria.limitations: A17 changes the four session-title owner packages, their declared dependency metadata and lockfile, scoped tests, bilingual docs, generated owner outputs, and the five exact app-boot paths that enforce fail-loud startup when sessionQuery is unavailable. Six other dirty app-boot paths predate A17 and remain outside its attribution.

criteria.description: The design preserves automatic first-prompt projection input, loads all eligible ordered human text through the inclusive generation watermark for all-prompts and explicit refresh, keeps query ownership in the provider layer, and adds no session-title to session-query dependency cycle.
criteria.limitations: The query observation materializes a fixed full prefix; the loader must filter to the previously captured inclusive throughSeq and dispose its lease after mapping.

criteria.description: Acceptance proves fallback-before-load ordering, the post-await current-work assertion before generate, loader rejection without provider-title append, and cancellation or supersession, disposal, session removal, and service teardown behavior.
criteria.limitations: A loader failure follows the existing service failure path; a fallback already accepted before the load remains in the Session.

criteria.description: Acceptance preserves the exact synchronous citation predicate using an invariant-owned committed-human-message seq index seeded from existing Sessions and SessionCreationBaseline, including blank and non-text human messages, while fake uncommitted events cannot poison the index.
criteria.limitations: The index retains one sequence number per human user/message for the live Session lifetime; keep it WeakMap-owned and do not broaden it into a core-wide index.

criteria.description: Acceptance updates every SessionTitleProvider consumer, both shipped provider plugins and dependency manifests, bilingual package documentation and pairing, scoped generated module outputs, the session-reader-migration customization owner, and the host app-boot audit that rejects both canonical and package-name aliases when their sessionQuery dependency remains unresolved.
criteria.limitations: Both shipped provider plugins must fail during startup when sessionQuery is absent, including profiles that assign custom Cordis entry IDs. The app-boot audit intentionally requires canonical IDs and provider package names; missing or explicitly disabled entries retain the existing audit policy.

criteria.description: Focused negative coverage rejects watermark leaks, stale generation after load, loader failure append, missing sessionQuery, uncommitted index poisoning, and invalid citation cases; the scoped production direct-read probe falls from four occurrences to two while retaining S071 and the existing-session bootstrap scan.
criteria.limitations: Run the canonical debt metric only when its complete candidate-tree prerequisite is available; do not claim a repository-wide metric result from this incomplete worktree.

fingerprint_scope.inputs: Sorted relative paths and working-tree bytes of all tracked files plus non-ignored untracked files under the four session-title owner roots; the five exact app-boot paths and eight exact generated/public paths listed in scope_extension; pnpm-lock.yaml; and .agents/customization-policy.json. The six pre-existing unrelated app-boot paths are excluded. Each path, NUL, bytes, NUL is hashed.

conditions: Keep automatic first-prompt generation on titleInput projection state; load complete history only for all-prompts automatic work and explicit refresh.
Capture throughSeq before asynchronous loading, preserve the inclusive cut, event order, human text eligibility, fork-inherited prefix, request framing, and logged model request exactly.
Keep ensureFallback before loading; after load resolves, call assertCurrent(session, work) before generate and retain the existing post-generation current-work check.
A rejected or cancelled load must not invoke generate or append a provider title. Preserve existing explicit-refresh rejection and automatic failure logging behavior.
Inject and declare sessionQuery in both shipped provider plugins, fail at plugin load if absent, and keep package direction provider helper to session-query to session-title.
Seed the citation index from existing-session scans and SessionCreationBaseline.events; add only committed human user/message events and keep pre-commit validation synchronous.
Do not change SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION, released Session data, persistence schemas, wire payloads, model-visible inputs, SDK outputs, or the sealed candidate.
Do not change session-telemetry capture in A17; S071 remains because the current observation cannot preserve bounded suffix handoff, redaction, ordering, and cursor semantics.

authority.scope: AAA-022 REM-028 W0-W4 owner-scoped Session-reader migration and bounded asynchronous reader, projection, and pre-commit seams
authority.decision: Implement the approved provider-owned Session-title history loader and invariant-owned committed-human-message citation index; retain the bounded telemetry suffix exception and exclude external release actions.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate if A17 changes model-visible input, adds a session-title to session-query dependency, changes released Session data, modifies S071 telemetry semantics, or requires external repository actions.

next_action: Complete A17 after a fresh independent review accepts the full 56-file scope and current implementation evidence.
revalidation_triggers: The implementation changes titleInput eligibility, request framing, the captured inclusive watermark, or fork-inherited history.
Generation can run after a stale asynchronous load, or a loader failure can append a provider title.
The citation index accepts an uncommitted event, omits blank or non-text human messages, or changes synchronous veto timing.
Provider dependency direction, plugin composition, focused cancellation/lifecycle tests, bilingual docs, pairing, or generated outputs are incomplete.

revalidation.authority_effect: No new authority is claimed. Confirmed W0-W4 authority and IR-005 already require missing sessionQuery to fail during load; this record binds the exact host enforcement path discovered during implementation.
revalidation.scope_note: Adds the Cordis API catalog, type-equivalence manifest, subsystem docs, and generated module-graph pair; the original gate and first two incomplete scope records are preserved.
